item.title: Senators Resist Last-Minute Airspace Rule Mysteriously Dropped Into Defense Bill
item.description: Two senators are leading the charge to strike a widely criticized provision in the annual defense policy bill that they argue would roll back safety measures implemented after a fatal Washington, D.C. midair crash earlier in 2025.

item.title: Megyn Kelly Explains Why She Didn’t Publicly Condemn Candace Owens Amid Charlie Kirk Theories
item.description: SiriusXM host Megyn Kelly disclosed on “The Megyn Kelly Show” Tuesday that she did not publicly weigh in on Turning Point USA (TPUSA) CEO Erika Kirk's dispute with podcaster Candace Owens because she was privately striving to bring the two together.

item.title: Patrick Mahomes’ Knee Injury Worse Than Originally Thought: ACL and LCL Torn
item.description: While the LCL injury complicates recovery, it “doesn’t necessarily” change the projected nine-month timetable for Mahomes’ return.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Elise Stefanik Stacks Up Grassroots Endorsements Against GOP Primary Opponent
item.description: Republican New York Rep. Elise Stefanik is racking up a slate of endorsements from conservative grassroots organizations in her bid to become the Empire State's next governor.

item.title: Single Mother’s GoFundMe for Handbag After Bondi Beach Massacre Sparks Social Media Backlash
item.description: In the chaos, Burns said she lost her handbag containing her phone and IDs and launched a GoFundMe asking for $500 to replace them.

item.title: Watch: Mexican Congress Erupts into Hair-Pulling Brawl Over Transparency Reforms
item.description: What began as shouting escalated into pushing and hair-pulling, with other legislators attempting to break up the fight.

item.title: Sharon Osbourne Says Children Kept Her From Fulfilling Assisted Death Pact With Ozzy
item.description: "I thought, I will never, ever, ever do that to my kids.”

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sanctuary State Allows Illegal Immigrant To Walk After Fatal Truck Crash Despite Fed’s Request
item.description: Washington state refused to honor an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detainer for an illegal immigrant truck driver who allegedly caused a fatal crash there, according to a Tuesday press release from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), first shared with the Daily Caller News Foundation.

item.title: Trump Orders Major Escalation Against Venezuela
item.description: President Donald Trump ordered a total blockade Tuesday of sanctioned oil tankers moving in and out of Venezuela.

item.title: FRANK RICCI: Trump’s Justice Department Ends Era Of Discrimination And Divisive DEI
item.description: The Trump administration is realizing the promise in the Declaration and reconciling the sacrifice of the Civil War by enforcing the Fourteenth Amendment. This strikes a blow against DEI, ensuring “equal justice under law.”
